tbesh_html:
1) to crush, be crushed, be contrite, be broken
1a) (Niphal)
1a1) to be crushed
1a2) to be contrite (fig.)
1b) (Piel) to crush
1c) (Pual)
1c1) to be crushed, be shattered
1c2) to be made contrite
1d) (Hithpael) to allow oneself to be crushed

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to crumble; transitively, to bruise (literally or figuratively)
strongs_1890.kjv_def: beat to pieces, break (in pieces), bruise, contrite, crush, destroy, humble, oppress, smite.
